description: An exchange rate calculator using the European Central Bank's official daily rate A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

amount.description: How much of fromCurrency to convert, in major units (dollars, not cents). Negative is allowed, since a refund is a conversion too.

fromCurrency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency the amount is in, such as USD. Case does not matter. Only currencies the European Central Bank quotes daily are known; an unknown code returns an error naming it.

toCurrency.description: The ISO 4217 code to convert into, such as EUR. The rate used is the ECB cross rate for the day, and the whole day's rate table comes back with the answer.

name: currency_converter
title: Currency Converter
